xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #3357

plan.title: bug(check,scope): completion vacates the done-gate - scope:complete then check yields soft-missing green with nothing verified (third fail-open edge after #3334/#3335)

narratives.Description: Completion then check must not skip acceptance after a same-session complete.
narratives.Overview: Completion then check used to take the verify-ac soft-missing path and exit 0 with nothing verified. After this story, completion runs the acceptance walk as a hard precondition and check targets the just-completed brief. One remediation string when that target cannot be used. Closes 3357.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer, I want completion to keep the acceptance walk fail-closed, so that completing a story cannot turn the final check green without verifying acceptance.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Run the acceptance walk as a hard precondition in scope completion. Check composition targets the just-completed brief instead of a soft skip. Evidence is targeted vitest on scope and check plus CHANGELOG 3357.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a completing brief with empty or failing acceptance, when scope:complete runs, it fails closed instead of accepting a disposition flag and leaving verify:ac nothing to check.
Given a story completed this session, when check runs verify:ac, the soft-missing skip is not used; verify:ac targets the just-completed brief under xbrief/completed.
Given the fix lands, CHANGELOG [Unreleased] cites #3357.
